description: Create a journal for a business expense paid personally by the owner.

deductible_vat_amount.description: Deductible part of VAT when vat_deduction_mode=partial, or an explicit deductible VAT amount to override the default or configured ratio.

vat_amount.description: Exact VAT amount (overrides vat_rate if provided)

vat_deduction_mode.description: VAT deduction mode. Use partial with deductible_vat_amount.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate as decimal (e.g. 0.24 for 24%; 0 = no VAT/non-deductible). Must be a fraction, NOT a percentage — use 0.24, not 24.

name: create_owner_expense_reimbursement
title: Book Owner-Paid Expense
